scope: Phase 1 of targeted deep-search of the 40 open municipalities: article-level/deep-review cases first.

findings: Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Amersfoort 2025 is current 04-07-2025 through 03-07-2029 for the new allocation framework.
The current 2025 regulation explicitly says opkoopbescherming was not re-enacted there because it continues from its different commencement basis.

The older CVDR674253 instrument has a current consolidated version from 04-07-2025 in which the superseded allocation provisions are marked expired; it remains relevant to the continuing opkoopbescherming provisions rather than being discarded wholesale.
resolved: why opkoopbescherming is not in the 2025 replacement chapter
remaining: extract continuing opkoopbescherming articles/threshold and current indexed value
establish current citywide room-rental legal basis and Omgevingsplan interaction

findings: Huisvestingsverordening Amstelveen 2025 is current and contains four-year municipality-wide opkoopbescherming for qualifying dwellings up to the annually indexed municipal middeldure-koop WOZ ceiling.
Uitvoeringsregels Wonen Amstelveen 2026 are current from 09-04-2026 and expressly implement the 2025 regulation.
For kamergewijze verhuur, letting a self-contained dwelling to 3 or 4 adults who do not form a household requires a kamerverhuur permit under the current rules.
The 2026 rules also contain separate treatment of second homes and prohibit specified tourist/woningdelen uses in a second home.
remaining: capture annual 2026 indexed middeldure-koop ceiling from its publication
address/location criteria and exceptions for room-rental permits

findings: Beleidsregels woningsplitsing en woningdelen gemeente Assen 2026 are current from 19-12-2025.
They provide a current Omgevingswet deviation framework for dwelling splitting and conversion.

Kamerverhuur may receive an omgevingsvergunning subject to the policy; maximum four non-self-contained rooms, one adult per room, minimum private room area 12 m2, and housing only in the main building/attached extensions.
Splitting/conversion and non-self-contained housing are limited to the contours in policy annex 1 and remain subject to spatial balancing and other criteria.
resolved: formal current room-rental policy and core limits
remaining: separate current opkoopbescherming framework/exceptions if applicable

findings: Huisvestingsverordening Delft 2023 has a current consolidated version valid from 01-07-2026 onward; it did not expire on 30-06-2026 as an earlier-version view could suggest.
The current version incorporates a 2026 amendment to article 3:8 and annex VII.
The 2026 leges items for opkoopbescherming and splitting therefore have a current substantive Huisvestingsverordening behind them rather than standing alone as evidence.
resolved: false risk that the 2023 ordinance ended on 30-06-2026 removed
remaining: extract current article-level housing-stock/splitting/opkoopbescherming scopes and annex VII
separately establish current room/tourist-rental and Omgevingsplan interaction

findings: Huisvestingsverordening Diemen 2026 is current from 01-07-2026.
Whole-home vacation rental is expressly prohibited.
B&B requires a registration number, is limited to four simultaneous guests and at most 30% of the main-building floor area with an absolute maximum of 50 m2.
Short stay is prohibited except in complexes listed in annex 1 under the regulation's conditions.
Opkoopbescherming lasts four years and covers qualifying dwellings at WOZ <=355000 and >355000 through 512000, subject to the acquisition/use conditions and exclusions in article 3.8.1.
The regulation also contains explicit transition protection for housing-stock changes that were lawfully permit-free before a permit duty applied.
remaining: digitize annex-1 short-stay addresses/complexes and any other geographic annexes
complete article-level housing-stock change/room-rental matrix for product encoding
